name: VTK-Based Transfer Function Application
definition: A method for applying color and opacity transfer functions using VTK classes (`vtkLookupTable` and `vtkPiecewiseFunction`) to map scalar values to RGBA components.
summary: VTK-Based Transfer Function Application maps volume rendering colors and opacities using VTK's vtkLookupTable and vtkPiecewiseFunction classes, distinguishing itself through advanced interpolation spaces and gradient-based opacity support.
